composition_label: Semantic search (Smart product search) -> Guided setup (Guided onboarding)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: synthetic=true, customer{id,name,kyc_status,kyc_flags,aml_flags}, ledger{format,data}, loan_application{id,customer_id,amount,currency,term_months,purpose}, products[{id,kind,name,description,currency}], query, optional top_k and completed_steps
shared_schema.canonical_entities: Customer/KYC profile; transactions with decimal amounts, fake accounts and masked cards; validated loan application. SYN- identifiers and FAKE- account/IBAN values are required.

ledger_formats.json: data is a transaction object array
ledger_formats.csv: data is CSV text with id,customer_id,amount,currency,account,description and optional card_number columns
ledger_formats.iso20022: data.CstmrCdtTrfInitn.CdtTrfTxInf array with EndToEndId, CustomerId, InstdAmt{Value,Ccy}, DbtrAcct, RmtInf and optional CardNumber; illustrative JSON shape, not the complete ISO standard

shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status, normalized customer/transactions/loan_application, semantic handoff, guided progress
shared_schema.validation: Shared ValidationError/require helpers; validate_input before search; validate_handoff before guided setup. Invalid input/file errors yield a single sanitized JSON error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: schema version, customer id, loan id, transaction ids, query, ranked products with explained scores, selected product id
cross_stage_handoffs.validation: Entity linkage, catalog membership, currency, bounded scores, lexical explanation recomputation, embedding bounds, scoring formula, deterministic rank order and top selection are validated.
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Selected product determines the onboarding step graph; linked transaction evidence and KYC/AML profile gate progression.

behavior.search: Inverted token index with deterministic synonym expansion. Default relevance is query-token coverage; optional local embedding callable uses 70% coverage plus 30% positive cosine. Stable ties sort by product id. Currency compatibility is a hard filter.
behavior.explainability: Every relevance score includes matched/query tokens, lexical coverage, optional cosine and exact formula. No credit-risk or approval score is generated.
behavior.onboarding: KYC -> AML -> transaction review -> loan application for loan products; other products omit the loan step. Completion claims require evidence and completed prerequisites. Returns blocked/ready/completed steps, next steps and progress.
behavior.resume: Copy guided.resume.completed_steps into input.completed_steps with the same selected product/query context. Each rerun revalidates evidence; output is returned for caller-managed persistence.
behavior.privacy: Card fields are masked before output. Free-text fields reject apparent unmasked PAN sequences; error messages do not echo payloads. This is demonstrative masking, not PCI DSS certification.
behavior.synthetic: Fabricated customer, explicitly fake accounts/IBANs, test-only card values, fixed example history and seeded randomized transaction histories in tests.
behavior.no_matches: Returns an empty ranking and guided status not_started with zero progress.

included: JSON/CSV and ISO 20022-style JSON payment ingestion
Screening gates and explainable search relevance
excluded: Live providers, networks, databases and external dependencies
Real KYC/AML checks, credit decisions or regulatory certification
Full ISO 20022 schema support or real IBAN validation
Authentication, encrypted storage and enterprise workflow execution
Automatic approvals or live financial transactions

test_outcomes.coverage: Both stages, synonym ranking, score explanations, injected embeddings, cross-stage tampering, prerequisites, progress/resume, KYC/AML gates, PAN masking, all three ledger formats, seeded histories, invalid values/shapes, extreme amounts, no matches and CLI success/error behavior.
